title: Technical Support Engineer I
description:
Why TrueML ?

TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML ’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions.
The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system.
About the Role:

TrueML Products is seeking a Platform Enablement Engineer I to join the Platform Enablement Team (PET) and help support the operational health of our platform. In this role, you will investigate technical issues, troubleshoot platform and workflow failures, support internal stakeholders, and partner with Engineering when deeper technical expertise is required.

This role is designed for an engineer who is building their technical troubleshooting skills and learning to independently navigate increasingly complex platform issues. You will work with experienced team members while developing proficiency in areas such as log analysis, API troubleshooting, database investigation, and application behavior. Success in this role requires curiosity, strong communication, attention to detail, and a willingness to continuously develop your technical capabilities.

Work-Life Benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Medical benefit contributions in congruence with local laws and type of employment agreement

What You'll Do - Technical Investigations & Troubleshooting

• Investigate platform, workflow, and client-reported technical issues.

• Develop familiarity with AWS services used by the platform and use AWS tooling and resources as part of technical investigations and troubleshooting.

• Use logs, monitoring tools, and available system data to identify potential causes of failures.

• Perform API troubleshooting using tools such as Postman.

• Validate JSON payloads and use browser developer tools to investigate client-side behavior.

• Perform basic SQL queries to validate data and support investigations.

• Reproduce issues and document findings before escalating to Engineering.

• Learn to navigate application code and system architecture to better understand platform behavior.

What You'll Do - Ticket Ownership & Operational Support

• Own assigned tickets from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation.

• Maintain accurate and current documentation of troubleshooting, findings, blockers, and next steps.

• Proactively communicate progress, blockers, risks, and next steps to teammates and stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of an issue.

• Provide timely updates so stakeholders understand the status of their requests.

• Identify blockers early and ask for assistance when additional expertise is needed.

• Support Jira triage and other operational responsibilities of the Platform Enablement Team.

• Follow established escalation, handoff, and documentation processes.

What You'll Do - Partnership & Collaboration

• Collaborate with other Platform Enablement engineers when troubleshooting complex issues.

• Prepare clear, actionable escalations when Engineering assistance is required.

• Provide Engineering with relevant logs, reproduction steps, investigation results, and business context.

• Remain engaged with escalated issues and help drive them toward resolution.

• Develop an understanding of platform architecture, services, and dependencies.

• Participate actively in team troubleshooting sessions, stand-ups, and technical discussions.

• Share useful findings and troubleshooting techniques with teammates.

• Contribute to internal documentation and troubleshooting guides.

title: Practice Manager – Paediatric Hearing & Allied Health
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is an Australian paediatric hearing services business that assesses children's hearing across clinic, school and home-visit settings, and delivers a growing program of hearing screenings in schools across NSW (expanding to 30-40 schools next year). Billing is mostly through Medicare and private patients, with a small but growing number of NDIS-funded families. The business is led by its Practice Owner, who this role reports to directly, supported by a small team of audiologists and casual screeners.

ABOUT THE ROLE

• A full-time Practice Manager role - in Australian healthcare, this sits above a medical receptionist, owning the administrative and operational back end of the clinic (patient and referral administration, reporting, scheduling and compliance) rather than front-desk reception duties.

• The role is split across two core areas: day-to-day patient and referral administration in the practice's patient management system, and end-to-end coordination of the school hearing screening program - from first enquiry through to the results summary sent back to each school.

• This role is trusted with genuinely confidential information - referrals, clinical reports, Medicare and patient details, and student data - so accuracy and discretion matter on every task, not just the obvious ones.

• This role is not asked to just follow instructions - it's expected to review its own work, ask questions, and genuinely learn a process once rather than needing it re-taught.

• Day to day, this role works independently across several systems (a patient/practice management system, Excel, Outlook, Canva, SharePoint) and will regularly hit things that don't quite fit the standard process - a missing referral, a doctor not yet in the system, a parent's booking details not matching their child's. The right person investigates and resolves what they can before escalating, rather than deferring every question upward.

• There's a lighter, ongoing layer of practice support on top of this - scheduling and rostering audiologists and casual screeners, social media content, SOP updates and compliance record-keeping - that adds variety without taking priority over the patient and school-screening workload.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

To independently and accurately manage patient and referral administration, and to coordinate the school hearing screening program end to end - on schedule, with genuine attention to detail and confidentiality - while escalating only genuine exceptions rather than routine questions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

▸ Patient & Referral Administration

• Upload doctor referrals to the correct patient profile, and create new patient records directly from an incoming referral

• Create new doctor contacts in the system, sourcing correct details from the referral or the practice's website

• Send completed clinical reports to doctors and parents once clinicians have finished them, and prepare clinician letters, including uploading the relevant audiogram

• Keep patient profiles accurate and complete - correct formatting, Medicare details and contact information

▸ School Screening Coordination

• Manage enquiries from prospective schools and keep a database of contacted, interested, confirmed and declined schools

• Reach out to returning schools each year to confirm the following year's screening dates, and manage the confirmation, flyer, e-contract and parent-broadcast process for each

• Maintain the school screening schedule and prepare each school's screening list ahead of time, sending reminders at one month, two weeks and one day before the visit

• Support the day of the screening visit remotely, including flagging any new bookings that come through

• Process each school's PASS/REFER results after the visit, prepare the summary report, and update the master database

▸ Staffing, Systems & Practice Support

• Schedule and roster audiologists and casual screeners across clinic, school and home-visit services

title: AI Resilience Partner
description:
EQL Tech is partnered with Convergent Research in the search for an outstanding AI Resilience Partner. Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): purpose-built, mission-driven orgs designed to solve technological bottlenecks, unlock whole new fields, and lead to scaled revolutions. We’ve proven our model works by building over 14 high-impact scientific organizations spanning AI (here), biotech, mathematics, climate science, and more.
AI capability is compounding faster than the world's ability to absorb it. Other technologies got decades to sort out their safety codes, their testing regimes, and the institutions that enforce them. We don't have decades. The defenses have to be built while the technology is still moving, and there's no budget line anywhere that says build the defenses now.
That's the gap this role exists to close. Not "how do we build another AI company" - plenty of people are doing that. This role is about building the missing institutions and technical infrastructure that make the world resilient to advanced AI: the defensive capabilities that won't be built by a startup, won't fit inside an academic lab, and are too important to leave to chance.
What you’ll do
Partners at Convergent are like senior partners at a venture incubator. You'll create and fully own a growing portfolio of FROs and other scientific projects that advance AI resilience - society's capacity to capture AI's benefits while withstanding its risks.
The portfolio is yours to define, but the surface area is much bigger than model safety alone. It spans defensive biosecurity (pathogen-agnostic detection, next-generation PPE, rapid countermeasures), provably secure cyber-physical systems and formal verification, epistemic infrastructure for a world flooded with AI-generated content, independent evaluation and monitoring capacity, compute governance, economic modeling of the transition - and areas nobody has named yet. The unifying question: what keystone defensive capability, if it existed, would make the world meaningfully harder to break?
You will have extreme latitude to decide what your portfolio should include, and the resources to go build it.
You’ll form strong theses, find extraordinary founders, pressure-test ideas, raise money, build boards, launch organizations, and help them move with the speed and focus of the best deep-tech startups.
Specifically, you will:

• Roadmap the AI resilience landscape to identify the bottlenecks and keystone capabilities worth building organizations around

• Source and diligence ideas for new projects and organizations and design funding calls in partnership with funders

• Build founding teams and help recruit the early hires who will make or break them

• Directly contribute to and coach founders on technical and organizational roadmaps, fundraising, and standing up startup ops from zero

• Serve as a Director on multiple FRO boards, keeping teams on track against milestones and helping founders make the genuinely hard calls on funding, strategic direction, hiring, firing, and operations

• Represent Convergent externally, building high-trust relationships with the philanthropic and public funders now committing serious capital to AI resilience

• Contribute to Convergent-wide initiatives like our Founder Retreats and Residencies

Requirements
Who you are

• You understand the AI landscape of 2026 in granular detail: who is building what, why, and on what timeline

• More importantly, you have a view on where that leaves the rest of the world exposed, and which of those exposures are tractable and through what clever ideas and technical methods they might be patchable, and who are the people developing those ideas

• You have ideas, or a credible plan to find ideas, for large-scale efforts that would measurably improve how the world weathers this transition

title: Director, Data Governance (REMOTE, WA)

Are you a curious builder who thrives in a fast-moving, data-driven execution role, curious about how AI can turn quality data into real, operational trust?
Veeam's business runs on data flowing from four source systems, v-Power for Sales, Marketo for Marketing, NetSuite for Finance, and Workday for HR, through a governed Databricks Lakehouse to certified outputs consumed by Tableau dashboards and AI agents. The Senior Director, AI-Ready Data Governance has authored the strategy for how this gets governed: a federated, pragmatic model, central standards, distributed ownership, sequenced by outcome so scope is committed on evidence rather than ambition. Continuous, agent-driven scoring keeps watching a certified object's quality on an ongoing basis, well past the moment of sign-off.
This is a builder and execution role for a deep subject matter expert, with full autonomy to move fast and deliver results. AI tooling is moving fast enough that the sequence of what gets built when will keep shifting. What does not shift is the outcome bar: certified data, a live trust score behind it, and a named owner for both.
This is a job for someone who is curious by default. Someone who would rather have an agent draft the first pass of a lineage map than wait for a meeting about it, who gets energy from ambiguity because the pace of AI tooling means the plan will keep changing, and who treats data quality as something they are personally accountable for at every level, source system to dashboard to agent output, ahead of whatever a report tells them after the fact.

• 7+ years of experience in enterprise data governance, data management, or GTM

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. title: GenAI CBRNE Cyber Security Expert
description:
Description
As a GenAI CBRNE & Cyber Red Team Expert, you'll adversarially test and strengthen the safety guardrails of GenAI systems against high-risk cyber threats - with a particular focus on industrial hacking, SCADA systems, ICS/OT environments, and CBRNE domains.
Drawing on deep industrial cybersecurity expertise (hands-on familiarity with SCADA, Modbus, DNP3, and PLC exploits) alongside CBRNE domain knowledge and advanced AI red-teaming skills, you'll design sophisticated adversarial prompts, multi-turn attack scenarios, jailbreaks, and model evaluations to determine when GenAI systems could materially enable physical-world industrial attacks or cyber-enabled CBRNE threats.
The role calls for an adversarial mindset: thinking like a malicious actor to find ways AI systems could be manipulated, combining seemingly benign information across interactions, circumventing safeguards, or exploiting model behavior to extract sensitive cyber-CBRNE information.
Key Responsibilities

• Run rigorous red-teaming of GenAI models across SCADA, ICS, and CBRNE scenarios. You will be probing for safeguard bypasses, dangerous capability escalation, and unintended disclosure of sensitive OT information.

• Design adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, and multi-turn evaluations against industrial hacking scenarios (SCADA, PLCs, DCS, Modbus/DNP3/IEC 60870-5-104/Ethernet-IP, critical infrastructure, hazardous-material facilities).

• Evaluate whether models can be manipulated into assisting attacks via payload generation, ladder logic exploitation, reconnaissance, or aggregating benign inputs into high-risk workflows.

• Document failure modes (obfuscation, role-play, decomposition, escalation), classify severity, and report findings to safety/alignment teams.

• Build repeatable test suites, adversarial datasets, and risk taxonomies; stay current on GenAI attack techniques and CBRNE/critical-infrastructure threats.

Requirements
Requirements

• Must be US-based and authorized to work (excluding IL, TX)

• Advanced degree in Cybersecurity, CS, Engineering, Security Studies, CBRNE sciences, or related field - or equivalent professional/military/government experience

• Deep industrial cybersecurity expertise: SCADA, ICS/OT, industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, Ethernet/IP, Profinet), PLCs, cyber-physical attack chains

• Strong CBRNE knowledge, especially its intersection with cyber/digital systems

• Red-team experience: penetration testing, adversarial simulation, vulnerability research, or offensive security

• GenAI red-teaming experience or aptitude: adversarial prompts, jailbreak research, multi-turn testing, LLM safety evaluation

• Practical SCADA/OT hacking exposure: vulnerability research, protocol fuzzing, network architecture analysis

• Adversarial mindset for identifying safeguard circumvention via decomposition, obfuscation, or multi-turn manipulation

• Strong technical writing for documenting methodology, findings, and mitigations

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on LLM red-teaming, AI safety evals, or jailbreak/prompt research

• Experience building red-team test cases, datasets, benchmarks, or evaluation pipelines

• Familiarity with frontier AI safety concepts, dangerous-capability evals, and responsible scaling frameworks

• Background in offensive security, threat intel, incident response, or adversary emulation

• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK (incl. ICS), NIST frameworks, IEC 62443

• Experience in national security, defense, intelligence, or high-consequence industrial environments

• Relevant offensive-security or ICS/OT certifications

• Deep expertise in one or more: GenAI cyber red-teaming; SCADA/ICS/OT red-teaming; chemical/industrial cyber risk; biological/lab cyber risk; radiological/nuclear cyber risk; or cyber-physical/high-consequence threat analysis

title: Systems Integration Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Position Summary

The ISR Systems Engineer bridges engineering and operations, translating mission needs into deployable airborne capability. In this role, your will lead systems design for the rapid adaptation, integration, and lifecycle engineering of airborne ISR mission systems onto operational aircraft platforms. You will support aircraft mission system modifications, integration efforts, flight test activities, and sustainment engineering while working alongside operators, maintainers, and cross-functional engineering teams. You will be successful if you can translate ISR mission needs into innovative, safe and compliant systems solutions delivering reliable, high-performance ISR capability directly supporting real-world operations.

What You'll Do

• Translate operational ISR requirements into systems design, specifications, and installation packages.

• Perform requirements decomposition, traceability, and verification across mission systems.

• Conduct engineering trade studies for sensor payloads, communications architectures, and integration strategies.

• Develop system artifacts including CONOPS, architecture diagrams, and integration drawings.

• Design and develop architecture for sensors, mission computers, data links, and communication systems.

• Define aircraft modification requirements including electrical load analysis, cooling, structural provisions, and RF/antenna placement.

• Plan and execute lab, ground, and flight test activities for ISR systems validation and verification.

• Support airworthiness and certification efforts (FAA and/or military standards, STC processes).

• Analyze test data and iterate system performance improvements.

• Configure and troubleshoot TCP/IP-based mission networks (routing, subnetting, VLANs, secure transport.)

• Build and validate software images to support integration and test activities.

• Execute software loads, firmware updates, and baseline configuration management.

• Support full lifecycle engineering from concept through modification, deployment, and sustainment.

• Manage technical risk, configuration control, and lifecycle planning.

• Ensure compliance with airworthiness, safety, cybersecurity, and operational security standards.

What You Bring

• Minimum 8 years of experience supporting airborne ISR mission systems with integration or aircraft modification

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

We’re looking for an AI Response Labeler / Annotator with deep expertise in Korean and the cultural context of Korea .
This is an AI annotation and evaluation role, not a translation or traditional localization position. Korean expertise is an essential specialization, but it represents only one component of the work. You’ll evaluate AI-generated responses across a broad range of topics, tasks, and real-world scenarios. Much of the content, annotation guidance, and day-to-day work will be in English.
You’ll perform side-by-side comparisons of responses generated by different AI models and determine which response better meets the user’s needs. This requires strong analytical judgment, the ability to interpret detailed guidelines, and the consistency to apply those standards across a high volume of evaluations.

• Apply Korean expertise when evaluating language, terminology, tone, regional conventions, idioms, and cultural context specific to Korea.

• Make independent evaluation decisions when examples or guidelines don’t provide an obvious answer.

• Maintain consistent judgment across a high volume of varied assignments.

• Participate in training, guided practice, calibration sessions, qualification reviews, and ongoing quality-review activities.

• Incorporate feedback and adjust evaluation decisions to remain aligned with team and client quality standards.

What You'll Bring

• Native-level or professional fluency in Korean.

• Deep familiarity with the linguistic conventions, regional vocabulary, idioms, tone, and cultural context of Korean as used in Korea.

title: Partner Manager, AI Native Ecosystems
description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies - from scrappy startups to global brands - use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.
About the role
Hi, my name is Marc, VP of Global Partnerships at Customer.io . A new wave of AI SaaS builders - Lovable, Vercel, Cursor, Bolt, and others - is becoming the default starting point for how software gets built, and each one is standing up its own marketplace or integration directory to connect what people build inside them to real backend services.
I'm hiring a Partner Manager, AI Native Ecosystems to make Customer.io the obvious, pre-integrated messaging and engagement layer for everything built on these platforms. This role sits at the intersection of business development and technical integration work: part of the job is identifying and recruiting the right platforms and negotiating partnership terms; the other part is working hands-on with our Product team to scope and ship the actual integration required to get listed and featured.
AI builder platforms are becoming a new front door for software creation - and a new distribution channel for infrastructure providers. Getting Customer.io natively integrated and well-positioned across this ecosystem now, while the partner programs and technical standards are still forming, is a land-grab opportunity. This role owns that land-grab end to end.
What we value

•
Bias to Action: comfortable building the process, not just executing an existing one - these marketplaces and their rules are new and changing monthly.

•
Cross-Functional Fluency: equally credible in a deal negotiation and a technical scoping conversation with engineers.

•
Ownership: drives a relationship from first contact through signed agreement through shipped integration, without waiting to be handed the next step.

•
Resourcefulness: comfortable operating without a dominant brand - you're earning the meeting, not getting it by default.

What you’ll do

•
Immediate priority: optimize our existing Claude and ChatGPT integrations, including MCP discoverability and GEO (making sure Customer.io shows up when AI tools recommend a messaging/engagement platform).

• Identify and prioritize which AI builder platforms (Vercel, Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, Google, AWS, and others) are worth partnering with, working with Engineering, Design, and Product to assess technical feasibility and distribution potential, including CLI and MCP connector priorities.

• Own the full partner relationship lifecycle - outbound, negotiation, and ongoing management - from first contact through signed agreement through shipped integration.

• Negotiate commercial terms (revenue share, co-marketing, marketplace listing requirements) directly with partner and BD counterparts.

• Translate each marketplace's technical requirements into a spec and work hands-on with our engineering team to scope and ship the integration - you don't need to write the integration yourself, but you need to be fluent enough to unblock it.

• Get Customer.io listed, verified, and ideally featured in each platform's marketplace or directory, and manage the relationship as review guidelines and requirements evolve.

• Track installs, activations, and pipeline sourced from each marketplace; report on which partnerships are driving real usage versus which need renegotiation or deprioritization.

• Build the playbook as you go - there's no existing process for this at Customer.io yet, and part of the job is creating repeatable criteria (target criteria, technical requirements checklist, deal template) so new platforms can be evaluated and onboarded quickly.

What we're looking for

• 5-7 years in business development, partnerships, or platform/ecosystem roles, ideally with a developer tools, API-first, or marketplace-driven

description:

Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Power Generation team is seeking an Electrical Technician to operate and maintain plant electrical systems at SpaceX’s power generation facility. You will work hands-on across medium-voltage generation, distribution, and balance-of-plant electrical equipment up to 13.5 kV and 34.8 kV. This is an operations and maintenance role - you will switch, troubleshoot, repair, and keep electrical systems online in a high-reliability, fast-paced plant environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform operations and maintenance on plant electrical systems, including generators, transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, motors, VFDs, UPS units, automatic transfer switches, and emergency/black-start equipment, at voltages up to 13.5 kV and 34.8 kV.

• Execute switching, isolation, LOTO, racking of breakers, and restoration of medium-voltage equipment in accordance with plant procedures and NFPA 70E.

• Troubleshoot electrical faults on power distribution, protection, grounding, lighting, and auxiliary systems using one-line diagrams, schematics, and electrical test equipment.

• Perform preventive and predictive maintenance, inspections, and repairs to improve reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

• Support plant startups, shutdowns, outages, and commissioning activities alongside operators, controls technicians, and engineers.

• Install, terminate, and maintain plant electrical equipment, cable, and control wiring as required for operations and maintenance work.

• Respond to electrical alarms, trips, and equipment failures; support root-cause investigations and implement corrective actions.

• Coordinate with operations, engineering, and utility personnel on switching, clearances, and electrical work that affects plant generation.

• Maintain accurate work orders, switching records, and as-found/as-left documentation.

• Follow all safety, LOTO, arc-flash, and PPE requirements while working in energized and hazardous plant environments.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 3+ years of experience as an electrical technician, industrial electrician, or similar role maintaining industrial or power generation electrical systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience operating and maintaining medium-voltage electrical systems (4.16 kV to 34.8 kV), including switchgear, transformers, and breakers.

• Experience in a power plant, generating station, or other high-reliability industrial facility.

• Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, electrical schematics, and equipment O&M manuals.

• Experience with LOTO, switching procedures, and NFPA 70E / arc-flash safety practices.

• Experience troubleshooting motors, VFDs, MCCs, UPS systems, and plant auxiliary electrical equipment.

• Familiarity with electrical test equipment (multimeters, insulation testers, infrared, and similar).

• Journeyman electrician license or equivalent formal electrical training.

• Experience using a CMMS or work-order system to plan and close maintenance work.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-discipline operations and maintenance team.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Cross-Functional Feedback Loop

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

- You possess a strong academic background or equivalent professional experience in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or Electrical Engineering, allowing you to converse fluently at a peer-level with world-class scientists.

title: Edge Compute Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Edge Compute Engineer to join the Latvia Design Center as the primary owner of our ground-segment compute and storage stack running the edge workloads running across all AST ground gateway stations. The Edge Compute Engineer owns the design, provisioning, and lifecycle of this platform across the full gateway fleet globally.

This is a design-and-operate role for a senior engineer who can define the edge compute reference architecture, build an IaC-driven fleet management stack, and take hands-on operational ownership. As the fleet scales, this role will also shape the edge compute platform for future edge functions beyond the current scope.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and own the edge compute reference architecture: virtualization platform (VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes), VM/container topology, storage layout, virtual networking, and resource governance across the gateway fleet

• Design the platform to support confirmed edge workloads with headroom and architectural provision for deployment of future edge workloads

• Maintain architecture documentation, platform design records, and operational runbooks

• Build and maintain Terraform-based provisioning pipelines and PXE/TFTP-based boot and instance management for consistent, repeatable gateway node deployment

• Implement Ansible-based configuration management and GitOps workflows to enforce auditable configuration state across all hypervisor nodes remotely

• Manage virtualization cluster operations (VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes): VM/pod lifecycle, HA, storage pools, virtual networking, and patching automation

• Maintain platform-level observability integrated into the central Prometheus/Grafana/VictoriaMetrics stack and support capacity planning as the fleet expands

• Enforce OS hardening baselines, PKI/certificate lifecycle (IAM Roles Anywhere, mTLS), encrypted storage, and firewall rules aligned with AST’s security governance

• Coordinate with on-site teams or vendors for server firmware, BIOS, and RAID configuration as needed; maintain accurate hardware and software inventory across the fleet

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.

Experience:

A minimum of 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, with a strong focus on hypervisor administration, Linux systems, and infrastructure-as-code. Demonstrated experience designing and operating distributed or edge compute environments.

• Deep hands-on VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes (K8s) - cluster management, HA/DRS, virtual networking, storage pools

• Advanced administration (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian) - systemd, network stack tuning, performance profiling, security hardening

• Terraform for infrastructure provisioning; PXE/TFTP-based boot and instance management; fleet-scale state management

• Ansible and GitOps workflows for drift-free, pipeline-driven configuration enforcement

• Cisco/Juniper networking (switching/routing), VLANs, VPN (IPsec/WireGuard), PrivateLink/private connectivity, last-mile network management, firewall management

• AWS hybrid cloud - Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, PrivateLink integration with on-premises infrastructure

• Certificate lifecycle management, mTLS, IAM Roles Anywhere, access control for production edge infrastructure

• Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics - hypervisor and VM health

title: Staff Software Build Engineer

This role is for a senior engineer who writes code, debugs real build failures, prototypes infrastructure, and scales systems through direct technical contribution. • Deep technical ownership with a bias toward implementation and measurable outcomes.

• Ability to balance architectural rigor with pragmatic delivery.

• Builds trust through technical credibility and consistent execution.

•
10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of hands-on technical ownership .

12-15 years of relevant industry experience.

title: Title Examiner Central States - Westcor Land Title Insurance Company
description:
Summary:
Title Examiners are responsible for abstracting and examining documents from the public records and providing title opinions based on the facts and documentation. This is achieved by using extensive title knowledge to examine the prior chain of title and all relevant documents for errors, identifying any title issues, & taking the necessary steps to ensure a clear title. In addition, the title examiner is responsible for providing accurate/ professional title commitments, while maintaining a high level of productivity in assessing risk and liabilities in accordance with policy provisions.
Essential Functions:

• Examine title orders within company guidelines to determine the conditions of the title and insurability by considering the effect of documents such as deeds, deeds of trust, mortgages, mechanics liens, tax liens, judgments, assessments, probates, and other matters of record

• Research respective title plant software, analyze & evaluate pertinent record documents for determination of ownership, legal description, & any conjunction to title

• Explain the chain of title, exceptions, and requirements to customers and managers

• Recognize title defects and formulate a curative solution

• Assess risks and liabilities that may jeopardize the company, and bring these matters to the attention of the local title manager, state title manager, or underwriter, as appropriate.

• Maintain proper production levels and delivery standards on a daily basis

• Work closely with the customer and management to meet time requirements for options, and assist with answering questions

• Prepare an accurate and compressive title commitment in accordance with company examining and policy procedures

• Perform other duties assigned by the manager

• Participates in special projects and miscellaneous duties as assigned by management
Job Qualifications, Knowledge, Skill & Ability:

• Familiarity with title searching software preferred, such as Ingenuity and County websites, etc.

• Prior experience examining in the States of MI, OH, IL, IN, KY.

• Knowledge of underwriting policies and guidelines for specified States.

• Knowledge of real estate law and title and escrow curative procedures.

• Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Organizational skills and ability to work within established time frames.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining control.

• Excellent problem-solving/critical thinking.

EDUCATION, Form Training & Experience:

• Minimum of four years of industry experience, including preparation of title commitments.

• High School diploma (or equivalent). Specialized training in word processing software, database or spreadsheet software (obtained either in school or by up to six months of training) is desirable.

Reasoning Ability:

• Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Physical Demands:

• The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

title: Software Engineer II, OSS
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Temporal is looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Open Source Server team. This team builds and maintains the core Temporal server. Its scope is broad, including Matching, Applications, Foundations, task processing, quotas and throttling, visibility, developer-facing primitives such as standalone activities, schedules, and streaming, and workflow experience improvements such as Continue-As-New, pause, and reset. We do not expect one person to cover all of these areas. We’re looking for an engineer who is excited to learn the system, contribute to new and/or ambiguous projects across the codebase, and help improve the reliability, performance, operability, and developer experience of Temporal over time. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll collaborate with experienced engineers to design, build, and operate components of Temporal’s distributed systems platform while growing your skills in distributed systems engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design, implement, test, and ship well-scoped features and improvements for the Temporal server with support from teammates.

• Work on distributed systems problems in areas such as task matching, scheduling, workflow execution, visibility, quotas, throttling, persistence, developer primitives, and workflow lifecycle features.

• Make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs with guidance, balancing developer experience, performance, and operability requirements.

• Partner with engineers, product managers, cloud teams, and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

• Improve the reliability and operability of the server by adding tests, instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and documentation.

• Participate in design discussions and code reviews to learn best practices and contribute to a high-quality codebase.

• Contribute to improving the developer experience for open source users and enterprise customers through incremental improvements and bug fixes.

• Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• Experience building and operating production backend systems (distributed systems experience and concurrency experience).

• Strong computer science fundamentals, including concurrency basics, data structures, and debugging.

• Experience writing production-quality code in Go, Java, or another applicable backend language, with an emphasis on correctness and maintainability.

• Familiarity with core distributed systems concepts (e.g., fault tolerance, consistency tradeoffs, replication, scheduling, performance), with interest in deepening these skills.

• Ability to break down ambiguous problems into smaller tasks, ask good questions, and incorporate feedback from code review.

• Comfort working collaboratively across teams and communicating progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.

• Experience with testing practices and an operational mindset (logging, metrics, tracing, on-call empathy) is a plus.

• Experience with open source software or communities is a plus.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.

• Exposure to technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, or MySQL is a plus.

• Exposure to Kubernetes or related tooling (CRDs, KEDA, Argo) is a plus.

WHAT MAKES YOU A GOOD FIT

• You’re excited to continue building and deepening your distributed systems expertise.

• You enjoy learning large, complex codebases, think critically, thrive in ambiguity, and enjoy solving challenging problems.

• You take ownership of your work, follow through, and collaborate well with teammates.

• You balance technical depth with practical engineering decisions and are comfortable iterating toward better solutions.

• You don’t need prior Temporal experience-you’re excited to work on the core of a distributed system used by a large open source community and enterprise customers.

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) im Außendienst - Hamburg
description:
Du fühlst dich im Vertrieb zu Hause und möchtest ein eigenes Gebiet im Außendienst aufbauen und verantworten? Bei uns heißt das: Verantwortung übernehmen, kurze Sales-Zyklen betreuen, ungedeckelte Provision verdienen und echte Entwicklungschancen nutzen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.
